mapper.select: SELECT f.faq_id, f.category_code, c.code_name AS category_name, f.question, f.answer, f.sort_order, f.use_yn, f.writer_id, u.user_name AS writer_name, f.created_at, f.updated_by, f.updated_at FROM faq f LEFT JOIN com_code_detail c ON c.group_id = 'FAQ_CATEGORY' AND c.code_id = f.category_code LEFT JOIN users u ON f.writer_id = u.user_id WHERE f.faq_id = #{faqId} AND f.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE faq SET category_code = #{categoryCode}, question = #{question}, answer = #{answer}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_by = #{audit.userId}, updated_at = #{audit.now} WHERE faq_id = #{faqId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
